1 In-House Programmatic Specialist (all genders)
1210 Wien, Job-ID: pze3wyxz 

Your responsibilities

 * End-to-End Campaign Trading & Optimization
You manage the daily setup, pacing, bidding strategies, and optimization of all programmatic display, video, audio, and connected TV (CTV) campaigns. You leverage platform-native bidding algorithms, frequency capping, and custom rules/scripts to consistently hit performance KPIs.
 * Marketplace Management & Publisher Relations
You negotiate directly with supply-side platforms (SSPs) and premium publishers to secure Private Marketplace (PMP) deals and Programmatic Guaranteed (PG) deals that drive efficiency and scale for our campaigns.
 * Creative Management & Ad Operations
You traffic and manage creatives via CM360 (Google stack) or Trade Desk's native creative library, ensuring proper ad serving, rotation, and format compliance across display, video (VAST/VPAID), audio, and CTV formats.
 * Measurement, Attribution & Performance Dashboards
You build transparent, automated performance dashboards to track media costs, tech fees, and platform margins. You implement and maintain conversion measurement using Floodlight activities, CM360 attribution models, and/or Trade Desk Universal Pixel & conversion events.
 * Stakeholder Communication & Community Leadership
You translate complex programmatic data into clear business insights for internal teams (Marketing, Creative, Leadership). You actively contribute to our internal Programmatic Community and share expertise across the organization.

Your qualifications

 * Deep Programmatic Trading Experience
You bring 3+ years of hands-on programmatic trading experience, with at least 2 years of intensive, daily work inside a DSP platform. Proficiency in one platform is required; working knowledge of multiple platforms is a strong advantage. Prior experience at a digital media agency or as a certified Google Marketing Platform (GMP) partner and/or Trade Desk certified partner is highly preferred.
 * Technical Expertise & Platform Mastery
You demonstrate complete fluency in Floodlight tags, CM360 container structures, URL parameters (Google stack) and/or Trade Desk Universal Pixel, conversion event configuration, and tracking parameters. You understand the technical architecture behind modern programmatic advertising.
 * Advanced Analytics & Problem-Solving
You possess advanced skills in data analytics with the ability to interpret complex datasets and translate them into actionable campaign strategies. You troubleshoot creative rejections, pixel drop-offs, and discrepancies across ad servers with ease and precision.
 * Communication & Team Collaboration
You communicate technical concepts clearly and effectively to non-technical stakeholders. You work independently and thrive as part of an English-speaking team, bringing both technical depth and interpersonal excellence. A Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a quantitative field is a plus.

Your perspective

Depending on the specific qualifications and professional experience, a gross monthly salary of at least EUR 4.000,- is envisaged (this in any case exceeds the minimum salary under the collective agreement). The final salary agreement will be reached in a personal meeting.

At our client you enjoy and value the freedom of a flexible mix of working from home and in the office. You will also benefit from a flat hierarchy and a transparent company structure. The position is available at the earliest possible entry date. This may best be discussed in a job interview.

How do I apply?

We are looking forward to receiving your online application!

1 Scientist (f/m/d) for Designing, Testing and Qualifying Next Generation Aeronautical - Batteries - JOB ID: 269079  * You will support the development of next generation batteries for aeronautical applications, from cell selection, module and pack design, prototype assembly, testing and qualification.
 * Depending on your background, you will develop and test:
(a) physics-based AI/ML methods for aeronautical battery design and validation,
(b) numerical methods for battery state and safety prediction, and
(c) high-voltage/high-power or lightweight battery prototypes, including structural and multifunctional energy storage systems.
 * You will interface with experienced scientists and engineers in the field of aerospace across Europe.

 * You will work closely with European Institutions and international partners from research organisations and industry on multi-annual large-scale collaborative projects.
 * You will build your own network, contribute to defining our strategic research direction, and prepare proposals for new projects with the support of your colleagues .
 * You will publish your results in high-ranking journals and will support other scientists in doing so.
 * You will supervise PhD and master's students.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner: 

 * PhD-level qualification in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a closely related discipline, with a focus on battery design and testing, preferably for high-voltage/high-power aerospace applications.
 * Alternatively, an MSc-level qualification combined with relevant professional experience may be accepted.

 * A traceable scientific publication record is an essential requirement. Experience publishing in high-ranking peer-reviewed journals is required.
 * Proven experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) physics-based AI/ML methods in engineering, (ii) high-voltage/high-power electrical design and testing, (iii) lightweight structural design and testing, or (iv) hybrid-/more-electric systems and aircraft architecture. The cover letter must explain the candidate's fit with at least one profile (i-iv) and support the claimed expertise with relevant publications and project experience. Missing information may result in rejection.

 * Programming skills in Python, MATLAB, including Simulink, C/C++, or similar languages are required.
 * Knowledge of the fundamentals of battery electrochemistry and understanding of battery modelling methodologies are highly valued.
 * Experience with state-of-the-art simulation tools (such as ANSYS, Modelica, or Dymola) are highly valued.
 * Experience in battery testing at cell, module, and pack level is considered an advantage.
 * Experience in industrial projects and/or European research programmes, such as Horizon Europe or Clean Aviation, including an understanding of the European aerospace research ecosystem, is an asset.
 * A high level of motivation to pursue a scientific or research-oriented career is required. Strong self-motivation and personal drive are essential.
 * English knowledge appropriate to the job. Knowledge of German is desirable.

 

What to expect: 

 * Employee benefits include a canteen allowance, health care support, pension fund, family benefits, additional leave, vouchers, sports and social events, flexible working hours with up to 50% home office, conference support, and individual training and career development opportunities.
 * Starting date is expected in Q4-2026/Q1-2027 (flexible). Applications will be accepted until September 30th, 2026, at 12:00 (CET). Early-bird applications are welcome since the selection process can start at an earlier stage.
